title: Sum an Array
statement: Read an integer n followed by n integers and print their sum.
hints: Read the count before reading the values.
Keep a running total in an int.

title: Reverse a String
statement: Read one line and print its characters in reverse order.

title: Fizz Buzz
statement: Read n and print numbers from 1 through n. Print Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5, and FizzBuzz for both.

tests.expectedOutput:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

hints: Check the combined case before individual multiples.

title: Palindrome Check
statement: Read a word and print true if it reads the same forwards and backwards; otherwise print false.
hints: Compare the original with its reversed form.

title: Word Frequency
statement: Read n words and a target word. Print how many times the target appears.

tests.input:
5
java code java learn code
java

hints: A map stores one count per word.

title: Remove Duplicates
statement: Read n integers and print the unique values in their first-seen order, separated by spaces.

title: Recursive Factorial
statement: Read a non-negative integer n and print n factorial.
hints: Reduce n until it reaches the base case.

title: Anagram Check
statement: Read two lowercase words and print true if they contain exactly the same letters with the same frequencies.
hints: Equal sorted character arrays represent anagrams.

title: Binary Search
statement: Read a sorted array and a target. Print the zero-based index of the target, or -1 when it is absent.
hints: Discard half the search space each iteration.

title: Stream Even Sum
statement: Read n integers and print the sum of the even values using a stream pipeline.
hints: sum is a terminal operation for an IntStream.
